explanations.text:
●  you ask the server for a page                          ([the answerer](Hello))
  │     You open http://localhost:8000 in a browser, or any address on that port.
  │     The server keeps one answerer for every call that comes in.
  │
  ●  the server answers every call with hello world        ([the answer](do_GET))
  │     It says the call went well, that the answer is plain text,
  │     and how long the answer is.
  │     Then it writes the two words, and the call is done.
  │     It does this for every address, so any page you ask for says hello world.
  │
  ●  the server starts and waits forever                   ([the start](main))
        It opens port 8000 and hands every call to the answerer.
        It never stops on its own; you stop it with Ctrl+C.
